name: Burning Chilli X

features.name: Wild substitution
features.description: Wilds substitute for all symbols except scatters.

review:
A fiery classic whose whole thing is choice: 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 lines, picked with buttons on screen. Wilds and scatters do the rest.

The wild covers everything except the scatter, and with medium-low volatility and lots of lines, wins should come along regularly. The cap is 3,000x, but the real headline is the 97.16% RTP – one of the best we list. It's basically the same game as Wild Tiger, so pick whichever you prefer: chillies or tigers.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
